notes.title: Attention: Yuppie Psycho MOD Contest Starts Now!
notes.content:
Attention, employees of Sintracorp! 

[b]With the recent release of Beta Mod Support for Yuppie Psycho, we're pleased to announce a company-wide [u]Mod Contest running September 6 - 27[/u]! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32192720/3a0f3012802172f6a7c9138f808b55e26b173e99.jpg[/img]

[b]We challenge you to create a small, engaging mod that demonstrates your creativity and dedication to the company[/b]. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3525540124&snr=2___]The Hawaiian Day mod[/url] serves as an excellent example of the possibilities. We expect nothing less than your best work. 

[b]The higher-ups will evaluate all submissions to determine which mods best serve company interests. Excellence will be rewarded as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] 🏆[b]1st place[/b]: Signed physical Nintendo Switch (VGNY edition) + Signed Brian doodle + Neon Doctrine game of your choice
[*] 🏆[b]2nd place[/b]: 3-character keychain set + Signed Brian doodle + 1 month Discord Nitro
[*] 🏆[b]3rd place[/b]: Brian or Sosa keychain + Signed Brian doodle + 1 month Discord Nitro
[/list]
[b]Additionally, all Sintracorp employees may vote for one colleague's mod to receive the Community Favorite award:[/b]
[list]
[*] 🌟[b]Community Favorite[/b]: Signed Brian doodle + 1 month Discord Nitro + Neon Doctrine game of your choice
[/list]

[h3][b]Rules & Guidelines[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] No homophobic, transphobic, racism, or any other harmful content.
[*] No copyrighted material (music, images, etc.).
[*] Multiple submissions are allowed, but each participant can only win one prize.
[*] Mod must include English, but other additional languages are welcome.
[*] ONLY use the official modding tools/support.
[*] Must be playable and compatible with Yuppie Psycho 3.0.10.
[*] ONLY publish it on Steam Workshop.
[*] Name of the submitted mod should be: YP_MODNAME.zip.
[*] Please use [Mod Contest] in the mod description so we know that you’re participating!
[/list]
📅[u][b]The higher-ups will announce top performing employees on October 2.[/b][/u]

notes.title: New Game Announcement: Catechesis
notes.content:
[h2]Catechesis Resurrects from the Dead on its 10th Anniversary Announcement![/h2]

[previewyoutube=MvCPf9B6J3Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Ten years ago, we released a teaser trailer for our first project, Catechesis. It was a small horror game that adapted Resident Evil mechanics with cute pixel art. To our surprise, we received an enthusiastic response that led to features on well-known websites like Kotaku and Polygon. Our trailer garnered thousands of views and built a devoted following of people eagerly anticipating this pixelated survival horror game. It was the early days of the Indie Game Scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32192720/11a3da8b7c4ee817d07106ea06a58f3b0ae0da6b.jpg[/img][i](Art by @BarleyJuice [Twitter])[/i]

However, as it was our first game, we ambitiously expanded its scope to the point where it became an impossible undertaking – a classic rookie mistake. Eventually, Catechesis was put on hold, and Baroque Decay shifted their focus to smaller projects like The Count Lucanor and Yuppie Psycho.

Now, ten years later and armed with more experience, we are thrilled to announce that Catechesis is back, and we're committed to completing what we started a decade ago.

[h3]DEVLOG #1[/h3]
Learn more about the game development history and explore new details about this latest installment of Catechesis.
[previewyoutube=FK3tJ1DAn4Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]SOUNDTRACK[/h3]
The original soundtrack for "Catechesis" will be crafted by none other than Michael "Garoad" Kelly, renowned for his incredible work on "VA-11 HALL-A" and the eerie, surreal score of "Yuppie Psycho." With his unique talent, Kelly aims to deliver a one-of-a-kind musical experience that players simply can't resist.

Listen now 6 exclusive tracks of the [url=https://garoad.bandcamp.com/album/catechesis-ep]Catechesis Soundtrack here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32192720/17b87bbe0108108b07154f031eb0c623cc3af483.jpg[/img][i](Art by Bani-Chan)[/i]

We still have a significant journey ahead to complete Catechesis, but we are dedicated to keeping you in the loop. Please show your support by adding the game to your wishlist and following our updates.

notes.title: Major Engine Upgrade + Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hello fellow employees.

Today we can finally officially announce the release of a new version of Yuppie Psycho.
We've been working on migrating our old game engine on PC to a brand new one.
Starting from version 2.5, the PC version of the game is now using the same engine as consoles.

This upgrade also brings a full [i][u][b]Steam Deck compatibility[/b][/u][/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32192720/ba27cdd56faba761170b72044eaf401647da8d38.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr] 

[b]The new engine is bringing : [/b]
[list]
[*][b]Unlocked Framerate[/b] : the game can now run at more than 60FPS, so smooth ! 
[*][b]Fast forward in dialogs[/b] : for the employees who can read ultra fast  !
[*]Better sound engine using [b]FMOD[/b].
[*][b]Linux[/b] compatibility is back
[*][b]Performances[/b] improvements and bug [b]fixes[/b].
[*]Higher compatibility with all systems and peripherals
[*]Updated translations
[/list]

[i]Please note that this update is only technical. No new content has been added.[/i]
If you have complaints, we strongly suggest you to take an appointment with HRs.

[hr][/hr] 

We ran a lengthy beta test to ensure everything is running smoothly on most computers.
However, issues could always happen and we'll do our best to solve it.

Please also note that we always keep branches of major previous versions.
If you feel like going back in time and have the vanilla experience, you will always be able to do it.

We really hope you'll enjoy this update. It was made to ensure the game is more future-proof and could be played for years by everyone.

[hr][/hr] 
Here's a little note about the technical part regarding saves : 
[list]
[*]As the engine is totally different, saves are incompatible without being migrated.
[*]Migration is executed at first run of v2.5. Depending on the amount of saves, it could take up to 30 secs, even more if you got a bit addicted to those witch papers.
[*]Once migration is done, after the game initial loading, you should find all your saves in the "load soul" menu
[*]Original saves are kept, a new saves directory is created inside the game folder root, containing the new saves.
[*]Progress made in the v2.5 is only compatible with v2.5
[/list]

We made a small update focused on our dear chinese players.
We often receive complaints about the game not responsive to keyboard input when the Windows Input Method is set to Chinese.
What happens is that the keyboard inputs are catched by the OS, and the game engine has no idea that an input even occured.

This update is here to detect this very case and warn the player to switch to international Input Method.

Thanks for attending this meeting, you may now get back to your cubicle.
